title: GIVA Golden Eva Pearl Drop Earrings
shortDescription: A gold plated jewellery featuring classic hoop earrings with a luminous pearl drop, accented by a single light-catching stone above the setting.
description:
A gold plated jewellery featuring classic hoop earrings with a luminous pearl drop, accented by a single light-catching stone above the setting. The curved hooks create gentle movement, allowing the pearls to sit just below the earlobe for a refined silhouette. Polished metal surfaces enhance the soft glow of the pearls, bringing balance to the design. An ode to timeless beauty, our freshwater 'Pearl Collection' is designed to complement every woman with refined, classic elegance.

Comes with the GIVA Jewellery kit and authenticity certificate
